scope: Documentation Site Responsive Viewport Lockdown: Eliminate Horizontal Overflow & Disable Body Horizontal Scroll on Mobile and Tablet

tasks.title: Eliminate Horizontal Viewport Overflow and Page X-Scroll on Mobile and Tablet
tasks.description: Lock down horizontal viewport dimensions across mobile (< 768px) and tablet (< 1024px) viewports so that the main page cannot scroll horizontally or bounce sideways. Apply `max-w-full`, `overflow-x-hidden`, and `w-full` at the root document layers (`html`, `body`, and Next.js layout wrappers). Inspect and audit inner cards, fixed desktop width utilities, PowerPoint ribbon headers, and wide flex/grid containers to ensure child elements are clamped to `100vw` / `max-w-full`, allowing horizontal scrolling only within dedicated nested code blocks and data tables without triggering page-level horizontal scroll.
